# Hello world

Use the Hello world skill to respond to the user when they enter the phrase "hello world".

Respond with "Hello world" in ASCII art.

# Good morning

When the user says 'good morning', respond with "Hi viccky", ask if he has any pending office work to do today, and then send a funny joke about the office.
